caption: The drawing depicts a single brown weathered object in the shape of a ram or sheep, standing on a horizontal, cylindrical base. The figure is rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter areas suggesting texture and the contours of the animal’s body and fleece. The animal is viewed in profile facing right, with four legs visible, as well as a prominent head and curved ear. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects, patterns, or scenery, and the primary focus remains on the centrally positioned animal figure and the bar beneath its feet. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner with fine handwriting.
title: Small Sheep Weather Vane
